draft-arciszewski-xchacha-03
XChaCha: eXtended-nonce ChaCha and AEAD_XChaCha20_Poly1305
S. Arciszewski, December 18, 2018

Test vectors reproduced from the draft. Section 2.2.1 gives the HChaCha20 block
function subkey; Appendix A.3 gives the developer-friendly (hex-encoded) values.

2.2.1.  Test Vector for the HChaCha20 Block Function

   Key = 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
   Nonce = 000000090000004a0000000031415927
   Subkey = 82413b4227b27bfed30e42508a877d73a0f9e4d58a74a853c12ec41326d3ecdc
